**Article Details for PMID: 42727044**

**Title:** Trastuzumab Botidotin Versus Trastuzumab Emtansine in Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2-Positive Advanced Breast Cancer: A Phase III, Open-Label, Randomized Controlled Trial.

**Authors:** Jian Zhang, Quchang Ouyang, Qingyuan Zhang, Huihui Li, Xu Wang, Ying Wang, Yongmei Yin, Shusen Wang, Yuanting Gu, Tao Sun, Jingfen Wang, Xinhong Wu, Fanfan Li, Xi Chen, Man Li, Jin Yang, Hua Yang, Zhengkui Sun, Jianyun Nie, Xiaojia Wang, Jian Liu, Xianjun Tang, Hao Wang, Zhan Huang, Weimin Xie, Wenyan Chen, Fan Li, Yuee Teng, Shuqun Zhang, Ru Zeng, Wenhui Wang, Lixia Ma, Yongli Gao, Haijun Yu, Xiguang Cao, Yan Qing, Xiaoping Jin, Junyou Ge, Hongxia Wang, Xichun Hu

**Journal:** Journal of clinical oncology : official journal of the American Society of Clinical Oncology
**Publication Date:** 2026-10-28
**DOI:** 10.1200/JCO-26-00602

**Abstract:**
To evaluate the safety and efficacy of the novel human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-directed antibody-drug conjugate, trastuzumab botidotin, for the treatment of HER2-positive unresectable/metastatic breast cancer (BC).
